notes.title: Update Notice [Version 1.0.1]
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for playing [b]SETTRIS[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, we have added support for the following languages: Korean, Thai, Spanish (Latin America), French, German, Italian, and Brazilian Portuguese.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you continue to enjoy [b]SETTRIS[/b]![/p]
